fields.Appearance: Orderly and ink-stained, wearing modest official clothes with every document carefully indexed.
fields.Backstory: A diligent administrator discovered years of contradictory orders hidden across separate archives.
fields.Goals: Trace who benefits from the confusion and make the administration understandable to ordinary citizens.

fields.Appearance: Polished and composed, with formal travel clothes and a case of sealed diplomatic letters.
fields.Backstory: A diplomat negotiated a fragile truce whose secret clause is now being deliberately misrepresented.
fields.Goals: Preserve the peace and reveal the truth without humiliating either side.

fields.Appearance: Well guarded but visibly tired, carrying ledgers marked with corrections in several different hands.
fields.Backstory: A tax collector inherited impossible quotas designed to make an impoverished district default.
fields.Goals: Prove the assessment was manipulated and prevent both revolt and collective punishment.

fields.Appearance: Severe robes, a measured voice, and spectacles repeatedly removed when considering testimony.
fields.Backstory: A judge convicted an innocent person using evidence later revealed to have been forged.
fields.Goals: Reverse the injustice and uncover how many earlier cases used the same false evidence.

fields.Appearance: Practical formalwear, a neutral expression, and a notebook filled with precise observations.
fields.Backstory: An inspector sent to investigate missing supplies found every local office reporting perfectly matching lies.
fields.Goals: Identify the shared source of pressure and protect the first witness willing to speak honestly.
